theme_strategy: Light mode primary for day-to-day point of sale and warehouse retail inventory management. Clean, crisp paper-white and slate backgrounds with warm emerald/forest green primary accents signaling commerce, sales velocity, and positive stock health, complemented by amber for low stock warnings and signal red for critical stockouts.

rules.sku_code: font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-600 bg-slate-100 px-2 py-0.5 rounded

entry_surfaces./: Overview dashboard — top KPI summary bar with today's revenue, sales count, low stock alert counter, split view with sales/revenue chart left and quick counter sale + critical alerts right

visual_enhancers.card_style: bg-white border border-slate-200/90 rounded-xl shadow-xs transition-shadow hover:shadow-sm
visual_enhancers.kpi_badge_style: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-medium

grid_structure.dashboard_kpis: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-6

pages.description: Main orchestrator hosting tabbed views: Dashboard (KPIs + charts + alerts), POS Counter Sale (Venda Balcão), Products CRUD Table, Stock Movement & Adjustments (Entrada/Saída), and Sales History modal/drawer.

components.name: DashboardView
components.description: KPI cards (Vendas Hoje, Faturamento Hoje, Produtos em Alerta, Estoque Total em R$), Recharts daily revenue line/bar chart, Top 5 selling products bar, Low stock critical notification panel.

components.name: PointOfSale
components.description: Counter sales interface: searchable product cards with instant quantity steppers, live stock limit validation (blocks exceeding available stock), shopping cart with subtotal calculation, discount/payment method selector (Dinheiro, PIX, Cartão Débito, Cartão Crédito), and 1-click finalize receipt modal.

components.name: ProductManagement
components.description: Products table with search by Name/SKU, category filter, stock status pill badges, modal to create/edit product with automatic margin calculation (Margem de Lucro = ((Preço Venda - Custo)/Preço Venda)*100), and delete confirmation dialog.

components.name: StockControl
components.description: Stock management interface: 'Nova Entrada de Estoque' (supply replenishment) and 'Ajuste Manual de Inventário' with reason notes (Quebra, Validade, Contagem, Devolução), plus complete chronological movements ledger table.

components.name: SalesHistory
components.description: Historical sales list with date filters, total items, payment method, formatted Brazilian Real totals (R$), and expandable detail view showing items sold, unit prices and profit margins.

components.name: LowStockAlerts
components.description: Focused view on products under minimum stock threshold with 1-click 'Repor Estoque' trigger button.

language_and_formatting.date_format: Intl.DateTimeFormat('pt-BR', { day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit', year: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })

motion.transition: transition-colors duration-150 ease-out, transition-shadow duration-150 ease-out

accessibility.aria_labels: All icon-only buttons (like delete, edit, add to cart, qty increment/decrement) must have descriptive aria-label and data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Backend Endpoints in FastAPI with MongoDB (Motor):
- GET /api/dashboard/stats: Today's sales count, today's revenue, total stock value, low stock items list, daily revenue chart data (last 7/30 days)
- CRUD /api/products: id, name, sku, category, cost_price, sale_price, current_stock, min_stock, created_at, updated_at

- POST /api/sales: items: [{product_id, quantity, unit_price, cost_price}], payment_method, discount, notes -> atomically decrements stock in MongoDB, blocks if stock < quantity, records sale document and stock movement audit logs
- GET /api/sales: list of sales with pagination/filtering and item details

- POST /api/stock/movement: product_id, type ('ENTRADA' | 'AJUSTE_POSITIVO' | 'AJUSTE_NEGATIVO' | 'PERDA'), quantity, unit_cost, reason, created_at -> updates product current_stock and writes to stock_movements collection

2. Seed Data in backend/seed.py: Provide ~12-15 realistic Brazilian retail products (Bebidas, Alimentos, Limpeza, Eletrônicos, Papelaria) with SKU, cost, sale price, initial stock, and ~10 past sales movements so the dashboard looks populated immediately.
- Build a responsive layout with top KPI header, intuitive navigation tabs, and quick floating action triggers
- Build the POS (Venda Balcão) with high operational speed: auto-filtering, instant quantity addition, clear visual warnings when stock is insufficient
- Format all values with Brazilian currency (R$ XX,XX) and PT-BR dates
- Use Sonner for toasts on actions (Venda realizada com sucesso!, Estoque atualizado, Produto cadastrado)
- Verify with yarn typecheck in frontend/
